name: fastlane
description: Easiest way to build and release mobile apps

repo.name: fastlane
repo.description: 🚀 The easiest way to automate building and releasing your iOS and Android apps

readme.summary: Clear purpose statement but all documentation is externalized to docs.fastlane.tools, leaving the README essentially empty.
readme.top_issue: No installation instructions, quick start, examples, or configuration docs in README—everything redirects to external docs site

injection_risks.description: The eval() function is used to execute the content of the Appfile, which can lead to code injection vulnerabilities if the file contains malicious Ruby code.

critical_findings: Code injection vulnerability in the AppfileConfig class
Potential exposure of sensitive information due to lack of input validation
security.summary: The code has a high risk of code injection vulnerabilities and potential exposure of sensitive information due to lack of input validation, but it does not expose error messages or stack traces.

common_complaints: Dependency vulnerability issues (faraday, jwt) remaining unresolved for months
Xcode compatibility problems (altool detection, deprecated command names)
Data type regressions breaking CI pipelines (non-integer build numbers)
Upload failures and timeout issues (firebase_app_distribution, gym)
Regression bugs that require verbose flags to work
sentiment.summary: Fastlane shows declining health with unresolved security vulnerabilities, accumulating compatibility issues with newer Xcode versions, and recent regressions suggesting insufficient testing or review capacity.

concerns: No commits in past 6 months despite last commit being recent (2026-02-10)
871 open issues with no activity or closure
Zero merged PRs in past 6 months indicates no active development
No active contributors in past 6 months
Unknown last release date suggests versioning/release infrastructure may be abandoned
positive_signals: Recent commit activity (2026-02-10) suggests repository may not be completely archived
Zero open PRs indicates no pending work queue
maintenance.summary: Project appears stale with no development activity, issue resolution, or releases over 6 months despite a recent commit timestamp that may indicate repository retention rather than active maintenance.

governance.summary: The fastlane project has a well-documented decision process and contributor ladder, but lacks a clear succession plan, indicating a medium bus factor risk.

analysis_summary.doc_summary: The README provides a clear introduction to the fastlane package, but lacks essential information on installation, usage, and configuration.
concerns: Docs: Lack of detailed installation instructions and examples in the README, with most documentation redirected to an external site.
